pages.text: Melons, sugar cane, logs, and small mushrooms share a universal sample for plants that grow or spread on their own.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Dirt$(br)Water Bucket$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Sequence and Delay$(br)Rune Plate: Numbers and Chance$(br)Rune Plate: Repetition and Sustain

pages.title: Choose a Material
pages.text: Use a naturally growing plant as the shaping reference. Craft the empty sample together with a matching plant to load it. Craft the bound sample alone to recover the plant.

Craft an empty Universal Base Sample for Plants with a bone meal sample to upgrade it. Load plants that require bone meal to spread, such as tall flowers and moss. Each generated plant costs one extra bone meal use.$(br2)Unload the plant, then craft the empty advanced sample alone. The original bone meal sample stays in its crafting slot.
